improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition and entry offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial mention and starting price addresses intent and reduces friction before the click.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a professional workspace built for business owners and traders. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product by name and clearly states what it does, building trust and clarity. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while addressing the target audience directly. The free trial call-out with 'no card required' reduces friction and encourages visitors to engage before hitting the paywall.

improvements.suggestion:
**Q: What happens after my three free searches?**

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan to continue. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the free trial ends. By clearly explaining the paywall transition and immediately reinforcing the low entry price and value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), it reduces anxiety and positions the membership as an easy next step rather than a barrier.
